note: Hand decisions on which DLD developer entities belong to each board developer (register_joins.py project_spine, lk_xref job developer_group). A decision here wins over the rules. Candidates for review are written to data/identity/developer_group_review.csv at each run. Entry: {"group": board name or key ("Select Group" or "select"), "developer_number": DLD developer number, "decision": "accepted" or "rejected", "by": who decided, "at": "YYYY-MM-DD", "note": why}. Never delete an entry: to change one, add a newer entry for the same group and developer number - the last one wins.

SOBHA L.L.C - 39 registered projects, 31,974 units; the brand's main entity. Sobha group accepted from developer_group_proposals.csv after reading the full list and the register. Rule set by Kendall 23 Sep 2026: projects Sobha markets under its brand count as Sobha even where the DLD register's developer_name column shows the landowner (Union Properties for Orbis/Solis, DMCC for Verde, Harbour/Dubai Harbour for SeaHaven, Dubai Properties for Ivory/Sapphire, JVC for Daffodil, Meydan for Waves, TECOM for The S) - the register's developer_number already carries the Sobha entity on every one of those, so the group is the whole rule. Siniya Island / UAQ / Abu Dhabi are outside the Dubai register and stay out of Najma.
